observation: The Kitchen 4, 3, and 1 review found touching dimension extensions, incomplete wall contours, implicit toe kicks, merged door operation marks, omitted drawer marks, and self-referential acceptance checks.
cause: The model did not keep structural measurement endpoints separate from visible extension starts, did not inventory unlabeled witnesses and toe kicks explicitly, simplified owner-specific symbols, and validated generated lists against themselves.
proposed_rule: Treat unlabeled witnesses as nonnumeric structural evidence; model supported toe kicks and complete context contours explicitly; preserve one source symbol per owner; route visible extension starts outside the complete envelope while retaining true endpoints; and validate actual exports against an independent source inventory with the normal validator.
verification_scope: A200 Kitchens 4, 3, and 1; ten export-level mutations; SVG, PNG, vector PDF, rasterized PDF, source/candidate comparisons, and two-build repeatability. Kitchen 3 horizontal-chain uncertainty remains project-local.
